system.description:
Your mastery over your elemental spark allows you to flare it more strongly, converting your elements into stronger, more advanced forms. Your next Focused Attack gains a new form and an additional effect based on which element you channel.

Focused Attack Effects:

  • Fire → Lightning: You deal additional damage equal to [2 x Arcana] and on an attack roll of Good or higher, they are Shocked.
  • Water → Ice: On an attack roll of Good or higher, if the target and creatures within 1 Space of the target were Soaked they become Frozen instead.
  • Earth → Metal: Your attack's base damage is increased by 4, the damage dealt becomes Physical and on an attack roll of Good or higher, the target gains 1 Bleeding Wound.
  • Air → Pressure: You don't need Line of Sight to target a creature within range and on an attack roll of Good or higher, they are Staggered.
